hostUsernames.description: Find Spaces announced by specific X accounts. Paste handles with or without @, or a profile URL.
hostUsernames.title: Host usernames

includeParticipantProfiles.description: Look up each participant's public profile (bio, followers, website, verification) instead of only the compact name shown in the Space. Adds one request per participant.
includeParticipantProfiles.title: Enrich participant profiles

includeParticipants.description: Add the host, speakers and listeners to the Space row and emit one separate "space participant" row per person.
includeParticipants.sectionDescription: Choose the extra data collected for every Space.
includeParticipants.title: Include participants

includeReplayAudio.description: Add the HLS replay link and, when a file can be produced, store a downloadable audio file with its duration and size.
includeReplayAudio.title: Include replay audio

includeTranscript.description: Produce a spoken-word transcript. Captions are used when the replay has them; otherwise AI speech recognition runs (slower and memory-hungry).
includeTranscript.title: Include transcript

maxParticipantProfiles.description: Cap on profile lookups per Space. 0 means every participant. Large Spaces with many listeners can be expensive.
maxParticipantProfiles.title: Maximum enriched participant profiles

maxSpaces.description: Upper limit for Spaces found through keywords and hosts. Spaces that you paste as links or IDs are always collected.
maxSpaces.title: Maximum discovered Spaces

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy and switches to Apify Proxy automatically if X blocks the direct connection.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQueries.description: Find public Spaces from posts that match a keyword or hashtag, for example AI, crypto or #Space. Each query reads recent matching posts and resolves the Spaces they announce.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Discover Spaces from recent public posts, or from the recent posts of specific hosts.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords or hashtags

spaceState.description: Only keep Spaces in this state. Applies to links and discovery alike.
spaceState.title: Space state

spaceUrls.description: Paste Space links such as https://x.com/i/spaces/1YpKkZgnrDXxj, bare Space IDs, or the post that announces a Space (the actor finds the Space from its card). x.com and twitter.com links both work.
spaceUrls.sectionDescription: Collect exact Spaces by link or ID. Leave empty when you use keyword or host discovery below.
spaceUrls.title: Space links, IDs or announcement posts

transcriptSegmentsAsRows.description: In addition to the transcript summary row, emit one "space transcript segment" row per timed segment.
transcriptSegmentsAsRows.title: Emit transcript segments as rows

transcriptionMethod.description: How the transcript should be produced.
transcriptionMethod.title: Transcription method

whisperModel.description: Whisper model for AI transcription. Larger models are more accurate but need more actor memory; on 1 GB the actor safely falls back to a smaller model.
whisperModel.title: AI transcription quality
